name: Marseille Almasreia Alkhalegeya For Holding Investment SAE
source: CRON 20261120_0440: bare alias and resolved statement unified from the same company's two copies. Period union taken; a blank rendered cell was filled from the alias only where the alias carried the value and its figures run at the same scale (unit guard). The resolved file's own value wins wherever the two disagreed, and every such disagreement is recorded in _alias_sync_20261120_0440.json. | Yahoo Finance series rescaled on 18 Nov 2026. The stored rows were in Egyptian pounds thousands while labelled as pounds, a 1000x overstatement: stored FY2023 net profit 56,267,054,000 is 56,267,054 EGP, and an annual revenue of 230.7 billion EGP is 170 times the company's whole market capitalisation (1.35 billion EGP at 6.52 on 207.6 million shares). The scale is corroborated by the Egyptian Exchange disclosure summary for the audited standalone results to 31/12/2025, which reports net profit 85,883,618 EGP for FY2025 and 12,653,184 EGP for FY2024 (https://foudalens.com/en/news/285591, EGX NewsID 285591). The FY2021 to FY2023 figures themselves remain Yahoo-derived and are NOT verified against a filing: the FY2023 and earlier statements are not in the exchange archive, and the FY2025 PDF is an Arabic scan with no usable text layer. EPS stays withheld because the stored 0.20 does not follow from the rescaled net profit over the listed share count. Income Tax is set to Profit Before Tax minus Net Profit: the source series carried a tax line that missed the reported net profit by 0.16 percent, and the residual keeps the identity exact.
